unstyled.open: The pinned shared panel only checks Mind Archive's legacy overlay.open for its merge-dialog bridge; Clipbind does not create this class.
unstyled.overlay: The pinned shared panel only detects Mind Archive's reusable merge overlay. Clipbind uses its own native dialogs and never creates this class.

dead.map: The CSS-in-JS heuristic reads A.palette.values.map inside the shared panel's palette template as CSS. This is a JavaScript array method, not a DOM class.
dead.palette: The CSS-in-JS heuristic reads A.palette in the shared panel's select template as a selector. The actual palette control is #suite-palette.
dead.values: The CSS-in-JS heuristic reads A.palette.values in the shared panel's template as a selector. This is an array property, not a DOM class.
dead.Reset: The CSS-in-JS heuristic joins the shared panel's two reset-confirmation sentences ('...stay intact.' and 'Reset this app's theme...') and reads '.Reset' as a selector. It is prose in the confirmation text, not a DOM class.
